findings.title: Test name/body promise-mismatch in tf3w_walker_is_a_subgraph_no_new_primitive_kind::primitive_kind_remains_exactly_twelve_variants (Q4)
findings.details: The test name + docstring promise: 'an exhaustive match over PrimitiveKind covers EXACTLY 12 arms ... non_exhaustive_omitted_patterns ... compile fail on the missing pattern — the load-bearing structural guard against silent primitive growth'. The test BODY does NOT use an exhaustive `match` statement — it iterates a hardcoded 12-element array (`twelve = [PrimitiveKind::Read, ..., PrimitiveKind::Stream]`) and a hardcoded `known: &[&str]` string array. If a future commit added a 13th PrimitiveKind variant (e.g. `PrimitiveKind::SubgraphSpecWalk`), the test would still PASS because the hardcoded `twelve` array would not include the new variant — there is no exhaustive match to fire `non_exhaustive_omitted_patterns`.
findings.pim_18_classification: Q4 test-name honesty + Q3 aspirational-prose gap (the docstring claim is FALSE — the test does NOT deliver the compile-time exhaustive-match guard it promises). NOTE: the structural backstop for the 12-primitive irreducibility ACTUALLY lives elsewhere (e.g. tf5_46's per-label allowlist + Subgraph::nodes() walker assertions that allowlist PrimitiveKind; the production cite-drift sentinel against CLAUDE.md baked-in #1; the §6.32 cite-drift CI lane). So the SUBSTANTIVE guarantee holds via cross-cutting defenses — but THIS test's individual promise is broken.
findings.disposition: BELONGS-NAMED-NOW — orchestrator-direct fix-pass to replace the hardcoded `twelve` array with a real exhaustive `match k { PrimitiveKind::Read => ..., PrimitiveKind::Write => ..., ... PrimitiveKind::Stream => ... }` over a sample variant. Or alternatively weaken the docstring + test name to match what the body actually delivers ('twelve_known_variants_round_trip_canonical_tag'). 5-minute fix; either form closes the promise-body mismatch. Named destination: orchestrator-direct fix-pass commit immediately after R4b convergence. ~10 LOC.
findings.would_FAIL_property: Per the docstring's own claim: 'If G-CORE-3w mints a 13th variant, this test compile-fails on the missing pattern' — but no actual match statement exists in the body to trigger that compile-fail. The structural promise is undelivered by THIS specific test (other tests in tf3w + tf5_46 carry overlapping but not identical guards).
